'''Gamoruk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who worked as a vendor on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold weapons to customers in the [[Alien Arms Bazaar]].
